description: Antennes Relais Petite Enfance (RPE) - Direction de la Petite Enfance, Saint-Lô Agglo - 2023 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Saint-Lô Agglo. The early childhood department of Saint-Lô Agglo includes 14 structures including 6 multi-care facilities and 8 Relais Petite Enfance (RPE) antennas. It informs you about the collective or individual reception that exists on the territory of Saint-Lô Agglo and accompanies you in choosing a method of reception. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Saint-Lô Agglo. The portal shows the English title as "Antennas Relais Petite Enfance (RPE) - Direction de la Petite Enfance, Saint-Lô Agglo - 2023" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Saint-Lô Agglo. Its keywords include relais-petite-enfance, 2023, petite-enfance, education-et-petite-enfance, saint-lo-agglo, structures-daccueil-collectif. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2023-09-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
